metadata.description: Marketplace for notify — a 100% local, free, offline attention plugin for Codex that plays a sound and speaks a short status update when you're away from the screen.

plugins.name: notify
plugins.description: Plays a sound and/or speaks a short, speech-friendly status update to get your attention when a long task finishes, blocks, or needs a decision. Ships a path-free uvx MCP server.
